mapper.select: SELECT pr.*, ri.room_number, CASE pr.type WHEN 1 THEN '租金' WHEN 2 THEN '押金' WHEN 3 THEN '水电费' WHEN 4 THEN '物业费' WHEN 5 THEN '其他' END AS type_name, CASE pr.status WHEN 1 THEN '未支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已支付' WHEN 3 THEN '逾期' END AS status_name FROM payment_record pr LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON pr.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pr.is_deleted = 0 AND pr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pr.due_date ASC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payment_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND due_date < CURDATE()
